newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fiery bus, truck collision kills 15 in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Fiery bus, truck collision kills 15 in Brazil.

text.p: At least 15 people were killed in a fiery explosion when a bus collided with a truck carrying hot asphalt in southeastern Brazil, authorities said on Wednesday.
Some 23 people were believed to be injured in the accident, which occurred late on Tuesday in Itaperuna, 240 miles (400 km) northeast of Rio de Janeiro, a policeman said.
"Between 15 and 18 people died and we're not sure how many were injured because they have been sent to different hospitals," he said.

Apparently, the disaster occurred after the truck, transporting hot asphalt for a road project, flipped on its side when the driver failed to negotiate a sharp curve. The bus driver did not have time to brake and rammed into the truck. The explosion caused both vehicles to go up in flames, police said.
Officials said most of the bodies were carbonized, making identification difficult.
